sudo -n dnf install -y lvm2 >/tmp/lvm_install.log 2>&1 && echo "LVM_INSTALL_OK" || (tail -50 /tmp/lvm_install.log; echo "LVM_INSTALL_FAIL")

rpm -q lvm2

set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: create backing image + loop device =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/srvdata-backing
sudo -n fallocate -l 2G /var/lib/srvdata-backing/disk.img
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup --find --show /var/lib/srvdata-backing/disk.img)

sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data

echo "== STEP 3: mount at /srv/data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n mount /dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data /srv/data
grep -q '/srv/data' /etc/fstab || echo "/dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data /srv/data xfs defaults 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "== STEP 4: populate application data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data/app
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "config-version=1.0" > /srv/data/app/config.txt'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "important production record A" > /srv/data/app/records.db'
sudo -n sh -c 'date > /srv/data/app/created-at.txt'
sudo -n find /srv/data -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort -k2 | sudo -n tee /var/lib/srvdata-backing/baseline.sha256

echo "== VERIFY MOUNT =="
mount | grep /srv/data
df -hT /srv/data

set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 8: unmount and merge snapshot into origin =="
sudo -n umount /srv/data
sudo -n lvconvert --merge -y /dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data_snap
echo "merge exit status: $?"

sudo -n mount /dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data /srv/data

echo "== STEP 11: verify restored content matches baseline exactly =="

sudo -n find /srv/data -type f | sort

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP: make loop-backed LVM volume boot-persistent =="

sudo -n sed -i '\#/dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data /srv/data#d' /etc/fstab
grep srvdata /etc/fstab || echo "fstab entry removed OK"

sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-setup.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
IMG=/var/lib/srvdata-backing/disk.img
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup --find --show "$IMG")
fi
vgchange -ay vg_srvdata
mkdir -p /srv/data
mountpoint -q /srv/data || mount /dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data /srv/data
EOF
sudo -n chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-setup.sh

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srvdata.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed srvdata LVM volume and mount /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service lvm2-monitor.service
Before=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srvdata-setup.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable srvdata.service
echo "srvdata.service enabled"

echo "== sanity: re-run setup script idempotently while mounted =="
sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/srvdata-setup.sh
